scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const parts=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.startsWith('source.part')).sort();const b64=parts.map(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')).join('').replace(/\s+/g,'');fs.writeFileSync('source.tgz',Buffer.from(b64,'base64'));" && (gzip -dc source.tgz > source.tar || true) && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('source.tar');const magic=Buffer.from('ustar');let p=0;console.log('tar-bytes',b.length);while((p=b.indexOf(magic,p))>=0){const h=p-257;const raw=b.subarray(h,h+100);const printable=raw.toString('latin1').replace(/[^ -~]/g,'.');const oct=b.subarray(h+124,h+136).toString('ascii').replace(/\0/g,'').trim();const size=parseInt(oct,8);const type=String.fromCharCode(b[h+156]||0);console.log('HDR',h,'name=',JSON.stringify(printable),'sizeOct=',JSON.stringify(oct),'size=',Number.isFinite(size)?size:'NaN','type=',JSON.stringify(type));p+=5;}" && exit 1
